thread:
jdoe_customer: Hey team — hitting the rerank endpoint and getting a 413. Request body is ~1.2MB, ~46 documents, some long html blobs. Response: \"413 Payload Too Large\" with no further detail. Can you advise?

tasha_support: Sorry you're blocked — can you paste the curl you used (sanitized) and the exact response body? Also which model/route are you calling?

jdoe_customer: Sure — calling POST /v1/rerank with model=re-rank-large. Payload sample:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":"How to reset password?","docs":[{"id":"1","text":"<long html>..."}, {"id":"2","text":"..."}, ... ]}'
```
Response body (exact):
```
{ "error": "Payload too large" }
```

tasha_support: Thanks. Two immediate asks: 1) approx token/char counts for the largest docs, 2) whether you can try sending only first 5 docs to see if it succeeds. If 5 works, send 20, etc to isolate the threshold.

jdoe_customer: Quick counts: largest doc ~11k chars (~2.2k tokens), average ~1.5k chars. 46 docs total ~48k chars ~9.2k tokens. Sending first 5 fails too with same 413.

alex_infra: tagging @olivia_eng — infra logs show the request was rejected by the frontend gateway with 413 before reaching runtime. Gateway log snippet: `upstream_response: 413, body_size: 1187456 bytes`. No helpful internal error.

olivia_eng: Quick thought — we enforce a combined request size limit (bytes) at the edge and also a token limit for rerank (we check in runtime). Gateway currently returns a generic 413 without field-level details. Can you try trimming the query text (not docs) and retry? Also what's the content-type header? If there are large binary-ish blobs (base64 images) they could blow up.

jdoe_customer: content-type is application/json. I removed HTML, kept plaintext; still 413. I can confirm docs are just markdown/plain text.

rerank-bot: Automated note: created support ticket #R-4321 and attached gateway logs + sample payload.

alex_infra: Repro steps for engineering: 1) POST the sample payload (attached in ticket) to the production gateway; 2) observe gateway log entry `body_size` and `client_ip`; 3) check if request reached runtime. So far gateway is rejecting at ~1.1MB body.

olivia_eng: Proposed short-term fixes: - Add clearer 413 body like { "error": "Request body exceeds 1MB gateway limit. Consider chunking docs or using batch rerank." } - Update docs to call out max request size + suggested chunking pattern with sample code. Long-term: investigate bumping gateway limit for verified customers or handing large payloads to streaming ingest.

tasha_support: I'll send customer the workaround (split into batches of 10 docs, or pre-rank by embeddings then rerank top-K). Also filing a UX ticket to change the 413 wording. @olivia_eng can you own the gateway message change?

jdoe_customer: Splitting into batches worked. Thanks. Please keep me posted if the backend will accept larger requests in future — this is a big UX win for us.

olivia_eng: Will take gateway message change. Filing infra task infra/edge#786. ETA next week for a more descriptive 413, longer-term limit changes needs product sign-off. Adding note to the docs PR for rerank limits. :+1:

tasha_support: Marking this thread resolved for now — customer unblocked with batching. I'm leaving the ticket open until infra PR merges. :white_check_mark:
